_about: Generated by tools/arcade-fights.mjs from tools/story-fights.mjs FIGHTS — never edit by hand. The 游戏厅's 斗法 (games/kapai.js): every fight of 卷一 as the road deals it at its first meeting.

name.en: The silver fox in the pit

hint.zh: 一身银毛，一条尾巴，尾根上八处断口；金色的眼睛，瞳仁竖着。
hint.en: Silver fur, one tail, eight clean stumps at its root; gold eyes, slit pupils.

creature.name: 坑底的小银狐
creature.pinyin: kēng dǐ de xiǎo yín hú
creature.goal: 受伤的野兽最凶。别打它——挡住它咬，站住三个回合。

says.won: （它不咬了，把脸埋进补丁里。）
says.lost: （它抬不起头，只是看着你。）

zh.stake: 卷一 · 沉鼎 · 第一回

creature.name: The silver fox in the pit
creature.goal: A hurt animal is the fiercest. Don't strike it — take its bites, and stand three of its turns.

says.foe: (It bares its teeth; a small, fierce whimper in its throat.)
says.won: (It stops biting. It buries its face in the patch.)
says.lost: (It can't even lift its head; it only watches you.)

en.stake: Volume One · The Sunken Cauldron · Chapter 1

goal.zh: 受伤的野兽最凶。别打它——挡住它咬，站住三个回合。
goal.en: A hurt animal is the fiercest. Don't strike it — take its bites, and stand three of its turns.

hint.zh: 狐的身子，九条尾巴，九个头，虎的爪子；叫起来像婴儿哭。
hint.en: A fox's body with nine tails, nine heads and a tiger's claws; its cry is an infant's.

creature.name: 蠪侄
creature.goal: 三试是胆子：在它面前站住四个回合，便算过了。

says.foe: 头头都饿了，汝先喂哪个？
says.won: 尾巴都垂了……吾回凫丽山。
says.lost: 砍得完吾的头么？

zh.stake: 卷一 · 沉鼎 · 第三回

creature.name: Longzhi
creature.goal: The third trial is nerve: stand four of its turns, and you have passed.

says.foe: Every head is hungry. Which will you feed first?
says.won: All my tails droop… Back to Fuli Mountain.
says.lost: Could you ever cut off all my heads?

en.stake: Volume One · The Sunken Cauldron · Chapter 3

goal.zh: 三试是胆子：在它面前站住四个回合，便算过了。
goal.en: The third trial is nerve: stand four of its turns, and you have passed.

hint.zh: 黑鬃，獠牙往上翻，一身泥甲，冲起来不拐弯。
hint.en: Black bristles, tusks curling up, a hide caked in mud like armour; once it charges, it does not turn.

says.won: 它掉头钻回了林子。
says.lost: 它拱翻了你，扬长而去。

says.won: It wheels and crashes back into the trees.
says.lost: It knocks you flat and trots off.

hint.zh: 灰背，眼睛在暗处发绿。
hint.en: Grey-backed, eyes green in the dark.

says.won: 狼群退进了松林。
says.lost: 它们围着你转了一圈，走了。

says.won: The pack melts back into the pines.
says.lost: They circle you once and are gone.

hint.zh: 人立起来比门框还高，一掌能拍断碗口粗的树。
hint.en: Standing up it is taller than a door frame; one swipe snaps a tree as thick as a bowl.

says.won: 它放下前掌，慢吞吞走开了。
says.lost: 它一掌把你拍进了草窠。

says.won: It drops to all fours and lumbers away.
says.lost: One swipe and you are in the bushes.

hint.zh: 狐的身子，九条尾巴，九个头，虎的爪子；叫起来像婴儿哭。
hint.en: A fox's body with nine tails, nine heads and a tiger's claws; its cry is an infant's.

says.foe: 头头都饿了，汝先喂哪个？
says.won: 尾巴都垂了……吾回凫丽山。
says.lost: 砍得完吾的头么？

says.foe: Every head is hungry. Which will you feed first?
says.won: All my tails droop… Back to Fuli Mountain.
says.lost: Could you ever cut off all my heads?

hint.zh: 像一只赤豹，五条尾巴，头上一只独角；叫起来像敲石头。
hint.en: Like a red leopard with five tails and a single horn; its cry is like stone struck on stone.

says.won: （打了个嗝。）
says.lost: （叼着灵草跑了。）

says.won: (A hiccup.)
says.lost: (It runs off with the herb in its mouth.)

hint.zh: 黑鬃，獠牙往上翻，一身泥甲，冲起来不拐弯。
hint.en: Black bristles, tusks curling up, a hide caked in mud like armour; once it charges, it does not turn.

says.lost: 它拱翻了你，扬长而去。

says.won: It wheels and crashes back into the trees.
says.lost: It knocks you flat and trots off.

hint.en: Grey-backed, eyes green in the dark.

says.won: 狼群退进了松林。
says.lost: 它们围着你转了一圈，走了。

says.won: The pack melts back into the pines.
says.lost: They circle you once and are gone.

hint.zh: 一身火红，尾巴尖一点白。
hint.en: Fire-red all over, a white tip to the tail.

says.won: （它丢下草，一溜烟钻进松林。）
says.lost: （它叼着草，慢慢走远了。）

says.foe: (A herb in its jaws, it looks back at you.)
says.won: (It drops the herb and is gone into the pines.)
says.lost: (Herb in its jaws, it ambles away.)

hint.zh: 比家猫大一圈，灰褐的毛上一身铜钱斑，眼上两道白。
hint.en: A size bigger than a house cat, grey-brown, spotted like strings of coins, two white streaks over the eyes.

says.won: （绿光一灭，草叶也没响。）
says.lost: （它从你肩上跃过，没了。）

says.foe: (Two points of green in the dark, unblinking.)
says.won: (The green goes out; not a blade of grass stirs.)
says.lost: (It springs over your shoulder and is gone.)

hint.zh: 红脸，黄毛，一只手攥着从药园顺来的草，一只手挠头。
hint.en: Red face, tawny fur, one hand clutching a herb filched from the garden, the other scratching its head.

says.won: （一树猴子哄地散了。）
says.lost: （它朝你龇牙，捡起你掉的东西跑了。）

says.won: (The whole tree of monkeys scatters at once.)
says.lost: (It bares its teeth at you, picks up what you dropped, and runs.)

hint.zh: 短，粗，褐底黑斑，三角脑袋。
hint.en: Short and thick, dark bands on brown, a triangular head.

says.won: （它松开盘，钻进石缝去了。）
says.lost: （它一口咬过，又盘回石头上。）

says.won: (It uncoils and slides into a crack in the rock.)
says.lost: (One bite, and it coils back on its stone.)

hint.zh: 一条狗，六只脚。
hint.en: A dog with six feet.

says.won: 它叫着自己的名字，六只脚一齐跑远了。
says.lost: 从从！——它绕着你跑了三圈。

says.won: Calling its own name, it runs off on all six feet.
says.lost: Congcong! — it runs three rings round you.

hint.zh: 野鸭的身子，拖一条老鼠尾巴，却会爬树。
hint.en: A wild duck's body trailing a rat's tail — and it climbs trees.

says.won: （它拖着鼠尾，爬上树梢不见了。）
says.lost: （你咳了一声。它在树上看着。）

says.foe: (A sound in the tree, like a cough.)
says.won: (Trailing its rat's tail, it climbs out of sight.)
says.lost: (You cough once. It watches from the tree.)

hint.zh: 灰背，眼睛在暗处发绿。
hint.en: Grey-backed, eyes green in the dark.

says.won: 狼群退进了松林。
says.lost: 它们围着你转了一圈，走了。

says.won: The pack melts back into the pines.
says.lost: They circle you once and are gone.

says.lost: 它一掌把你拍进了草窠。

says.won: It drops to all fours and lumbers away.
says.lost: One swipe and you are in the bushes.

hint.zh: 龟的样子，白身子，红脑袋。
hint.en: A turtle's shape, a white body and a red head.

says.foe: 吾缩甲中，火不能侵，汝亦不能。
says.won: 甲裂了……吾让路便是。
says.lost: 甲还在，汝的力气没了。

zh.stake: 卷一 · 沉鼎 · 第五回

says.foe: In my shell, fire cannot reach me. Nor can you.
says.won: My shell cracks… I will make way.
says.lost: The shell holds. Your strength does not.

en.stake: Volume One · The Sunken Cauldron · Chapter 5

hint.zh: 彭城赤松观的黄袍，练气九层；白净脸，笑眯眯的。
hint.en: A yellow robe of the Red Pine Abbey at Pengcheng, layer nine of Qi Condensation; pale-faced, always smiling.

creature.name: 邹青松
creature.goal: 被追着打：他有一面盾，结丹以下，无人能破——打不穿他。撑到他出完每一招，便算过了。

says.won: 你这踏马的符是哪来的！？
says.lost: 结丹以下，无人能破。

zh.stake: 卷一 · 沉鼎 · 第五回

creature.name: Zou Qingsong
creature.goal: Chased and beaten: his shield, they say, nothing short of Core Formation can break — you will not get through it. Last until he has spent every move, and you have passed.

says.won: Where the hell did you get that hell-for-leather charm!?
says.lost: Nothing short of Core Formation can break it.

en.stake: Volume One · The Sunken Cauldron · Chapter 5

goal.zh: 被追着打：他有一面盾，结丹以下，无人能破——打不穿他。撑到他出完每一招，便算过了。
goal.en: Chased and beaten: his shield, they say, nothing short of Core Formation can break — you will not get through it. Last until he has spent every move, and you have passed.

hint.zh: 兔子大小，鸟嘴，一双猫头鹰的圆眼，拖一条蛇尾巴；人一走近，它便倒下装死。
hint.en: Rabbit-sized, with a bird's beak, round owl's eyes and a snake's tail; the moment anyone comes near, it falls over and plays dead.

says.won: 它睁开一只鸱眼，溜了。
says.lost: 它还睡着——你的人已经倒了。

says.foe: (It shuts its eyes and rolls belly-up.)
says.won: It opens one owl's eye and slips away.
says.lost: It is still asleep — and your people are down.

en.stake: The stair of the Cliff of Danger

name.en: It Sleeps at the Sight of Men

feint._about: 装睡 (battle.js § asleep): its first two turns it lies still; a blow not of metal glances (lands 1) and is counted; 金克木 — metal goes in whole (小满 coats 火柴 in metal light), and so does every blow of a turn in which a bind was played at it (`pierce_binds`: 阿禾 binds it, 小满 strikes). It wakes with 鸱目一睁, 3 harder for every blow that glanced.

hint.zh: 一头比牛还大的彘，黄毛，红尾巴拖在身后像一条火；那张脸是人的，像谁都像，像谁都不像。
hint.en: A pig bigger than an ox, yellow-haired, a red tail dragging behind like a trail of fire; the face is a man's — like everyone, like no one.

says.won: 它拖着那张人脸，滚进坑里不动了。
says.lost: 哭声停了。你也没了声。

says.foe: The crying is the bait. You are the fish.
says.won: It drags its human face into the pit and lies still.
says.lost: The crying stops. So do you.

hint.zh: 兔子大小，鸟嘴，一双猫头鹰的圆眼，拖一条蛇尾巴；人一走近，它便倒下装死。
hint.en: Rabbit-sized, with a bird's beak, round owl's eyes and a snake's tail; the moment anyone comes near, it falls over and plays dead.

says.won: 它睁开一只鸱眼，溜了。
says.lost: 它还睡着——你的人已经倒了。

says.foe: (It shuts its eyes and rolls belly-up.)
says.won: It opens one owl's eye and slips away.
says.lost: It is still asleep — and your people are down.

name.en: It Sleeps at the Sight of Men

feint._about: 装睡 (battle.js § asleep): its first two turns it lies still; a blow not of metal glances (lands 1) and is counted; 金克木 — metal goes in whole (小满 coats 火柴 in metal light), and so does every blow of a turn in which a bind was played at it (`pierce_binds`: 阿禾 binds it, 小满 strikes). It wakes with 鸱目一睁, 3 harder for every blow that glanced.

hint.zh: 一头牛，身上却是老虎的纹。
hint.en: An ox, striped like a tiger.

says.won: 它叫着自己的名字，往空桑那边去了。
says.lost: 軨軨——脚底下的地，渗出水来。

says.won: Calling its own name, it goes off toward Kongsang.
says.lost: Lingling — water seeps up from the ground at your feet.

hint.zh: 内门的练气六层，三十出头，一张长脸，眼皮总耷拉着；外门熬了九年才进的内门，熬白了半头头发，最见不得外门的人往台上爬。
hint.en: Layer six of Qi Condensation in the inner court, a little past thirty, long-faced, eyelids always drooping; nine years grinding in the outer court before he made the inner, and half his hair went white for it — he can't bear to see an outer disciple climb onto the stage.

says.foe: 外门的，一个比一个不知道天高地厚。
says.won: ……外门的？
says.lost: 下去吧。

zh.stake: 卷一 · 沉鼎 · 第六回

says.foe: Outer court — each one knows less of heaven and earth than the last.
says.won: …Outer court?
says.lost: Get down.

en.stake: Volume One · The Sunken Cauldron · Chapter 6

hint.zh: 在外门排了三年队、等着进内门的真灵根，练气六层；淡蓝的衣裳，一口下品的法器剑，剑气出去三尺，左手捻得出冰锥；袖子里扣着一张雷符，始终没掏。
hint.en: A true-root disciple at layer six who has queued three years in the outer court for the inner court; in pale blue, with a low-grade magic sword whose breath runs three feet past the point, and ice spikes at a twist of her left hand; a thunder talisman held in her sleeve, never drawn.

creature.name: 秦雁
creature.goal: 三十招：看她的脚，在台上撑过七个回合，便算过了。

says.won: 掉下台的，输。规矩上，就是输了。
says.lost: 我说过，不让。

zh.stake: 卷一 · 沉鼎 · 第六回

creature.name: Qin Yan
creature.goal: Thirty moves: watch her feet and stand seven turns on the stage, and you have passed.

says.foe: I won't give way to you. Don't you give way to me.
says.won: Off the stage, you lose. By the rules, I've lost.
says.lost: I told you: I won't give way.

en.stake: Volume One · The Sunken Cauldron · Chapter 6

goal.zh: 三十招：看她的脚，在台上撑过七个回合，便算过了。
goal.en: Thirty moves: watch her feet and stand seven turns on the stage, and you have passed.

hint.zh: 一身新法衣，腰里挂着那面铜镜——穿白的仙长留给他爹的。
hint.en: A new robe, and at his waist that bronze mirror — the one the man in white left with his father.

says.foe: 你跪下，叫三声爷爷，我让你滚下去。
says.won: 我——我爹是——
says.lost: 看见没？这就是懂事的。

zh.stake: 卷一 · 沉鼎 · 第六回

says.foe: Kneel, call me grandpa three times, and I'll let you crawl off.
says.won: My—my father is—
says.lost: See? That's what knowing your place looks like.

en.stake: Volume One · The Sunken Cauldron · Chapter 6

hint.zh: 青灰的背，胸前一道道横纹，眼睛黄得发亮。
hint.en: Slate-grey back, barred breast, eyes a bright hard yellow.

says.won: （它一振翅，斜斜地滑下崖去。）
says.lost: （爪子擦过你的头皮，它又上了天。）

says.foe: (A long scream from the cliff top.)
says.won: (One beat of its wings, and it slants away down the cliff.)
says.lost: (Its talons graze your scalp, and it is back in the sky.)

hint.zh: 一头麋鹿，眼睛却是鱼的——圆，鼓，不会眨。
hint.en: An elk — with a fish's eyes: round, bulging, lidless.

says.won: 它叫着自己的名字，跃进荆棘丛里。
says.lost: 妴胡——鱼眼还盯着你。

says.won: Calling its own name, it leaps into the thorns.
says.lost: Yuanhu — the fish eye is still on you.

hint.zh: 牛的身子，后头甩着一条马尾巴。
hint.en: An ox's body swinging a horse's tail.

says.won: 它甩着马尾，叫着自己的名字走了。
says.lost: 精精！——它把你顶进了草里。

says.won: Swishing its horse's tail, it walks off calling its own name.
says.lost: Jingjing! — it butts you into the grass.

hint.zh: 兔子大小，鸟嘴，一双猫头鹰的圆眼，拖一条蛇尾巴；人一走近，它便倒下装死。
hint.en: Rabbit-sized, with a bird's beak, round owl's eyes and a snake's tail; the moment anyone comes near, it falls over and plays dead.

says.won: 它睁开一只鸱眼，溜了。
says.lost: 它还睡着——你的人已经倒了。

zh.stake: 卷一 · 沉鼎 · 第七回

says.foe: (It shuts its eyes and rolls belly-up.)
says.won: It opens one owl's eye and slips away.
says.lost: It is still asleep — and your people are down.

en.stake: Volume One · The Sunken Cauldron · Chapter 7

creature.name: 秦雁
creature.goal: 这回的台子是整座崖，没有台边。看她的脚，撑过八个回合，便算过了。

says.won: 掉下台的，输。规矩上，就是输了。
says.lost: 我说过，不让。

zh.stake: 卷一 · 沉鼎 · 第七回

creature.name: Qin Yan
creature.goal: This time the stage is the whole cliff, with no edge. Watch her feet; stand eight turns, and you have passed.

says.foe: I won't give way to you. Don't you give way to me.
says.won: Off the stage, you lose. By the rules, I've lost.
says.lost: I told you: I won't give way.

en.stake: Volume One · The Sunken Cauldron · Chapter 7

goal.zh: 这回的台子是整座崖，没有台边。看她的脚，撑过八个回合，便算过了。
goal.en: This time the stage is the whole cliff, with no edge. Watch her feet; stand eight turns, and you have passed.

hint.zh: 比狼小，一身锈红，尾巴黑而蓬。
hint.en: Smaller than a wolf, rust-red, a black brush of a tail.

says.won: （一声短吠，红影子四下散了。）
says.lost: （它们没追，只是看着你走。）

says.foe: (One in front — and more in the grass.)
says.won: (A short yap, and the red shapes scatter.)
says.lost: (They don't follow; they just watch you go.)

hint.zh: 狐狸的身子，背上一对翅膀。
hint.en: A fox's body, a pair of wings on its back.

says.foe: （头顶一声雁叫，可天上没有雁。）
says.won: （它展翅往南去了，风里带着焦味。）
says.lost: （雁声远了。你嘴唇干得裂开。）

says.foe: (A goose cries overhead — but there are no geese.)
says.won: (It spreads its wings and goes south; the wind smells scorched.)
says.lost: (The goose-cry fades. Your lips have cracked with dryness.)

hint.zh: 一头小猪，嘴边两颗獠牙。
hint.en: A young pig with two tusks at its lips.

says.won: 它拱开一片土，叫着自己的名字跑了。
says.lost: 当康！——它在你身边转了一圈，像在道喜。

says.won: It roots up a patch of earth and runs off calling its own name.
says.lost: Dangkang! — it trots a ring round you, as if wishing you joy.

hint.zh: 内门的练气九层圆满，五年大比的决赛就是他。
hint.en: Inner court, layer nine and full — the final of the fifth year's contest.

says.won: 我认输。
says.lost: 下去吧。

zh.stake: 卷一 · 沉鼎 · 第八回

says.won: I yield.
says.lost: Get down.

en.stake: Volume One · The Sunken Cauldron · Chapter 8

hint.zh: 狼的身子，一颗红脑袋，一对老鼠的小眼睛。
hint.en: A wolf's body, a red head, a rat's small eyes.

says.won: （红脑袋缩回黑里，哼声远了。）
says.lost: 哼哼……它舔了舔嘴。

says.won: (The red head draws back into the dark; the grunting fades.)
says.lost: Hnn… it licks its lips.

hint.zh: 一只白头的鸡，脚是老鼠的，爪子却是老虎的。
hint.en: A white-headed fowl on rat's feet, with tiger's claws.

says.won: （它扑着短翅，跳下崖去了。）
says.lost: （它在石头上磨了磨爪子。）

says.won: (Flapping its stubby wings, it hops down the cliff.)
says.lost: (It whets its claws on the stone.)

hint.zh: 河伯脚下的两条青龙，鳞片有磨盘那么大；一条扑，一条扫。
hint.en: The two blue dragons under the River Lord's feet, scales as big as millstones; one lunges, one sweeps.

creature.name: 冰夷双龙
creature.title: 冰夷之试
creature.goal: 这是试，不是斗：撑到双龙出完招，或把它们逼到三成气血，便算过了。

says.won: 不避。可。
says.lost: 跪下吧，凡人。

zh.stake: 卷一 · 沉鼎 · 第九回

creature.name: Bingyi's twin dragons
creature.title: Bingyi's Trial
creature.goal: A trial, not a fight: stand until the dragons have spent every move, or drive them down to a third, and you have passed.

says.foe: The one who stands while all kneel: we test you.
says.won: You did not step aside. Enough.
says.lost: Kneel, mortal.

en.stake: Volume One · The Sunken Cauldron · Chapter 9

goal.zh: 这是试，不是斗：撑到双龙出完招，或把它们逼到三成气血，便算过了。
goal.en: A trial, not a fight: stand until the dragons have spent every move, or drive them down to a third, and you have passed.

hint.zh: 太一宫的白衣执事，筑基大成，在筑基上卡了三十年。
hint.en: A white-robed steward of the Taiyi Palace, Foundation complete — stuck at the Foundation thirty years.

creature.name: 老井
creature.title: 河滩 · 老井
creature.goal: 他是筑基大成，你打不穿他那一层光。躲开那根指头，撑到他出完每一招——阿禾还蹲在岸边。

says.won: 这一笔，记下了。
says.lost: 没有人护着你。

zh.stake: 卷一 · 沉鼎 · 第九回

creature.name: Old Well
creature.title: The river bank · Old Well
creature.goal: He is Foundation complete; you will not get through that layer of light. Dodge the finger and last until he has spent every move — Ahe is still crouched by the water.

says.won: This entry is written down.
says.lost: No one is guarding you.

en.stake: Volume One · The Sunken Cauldron · Chapter 9

goal.zh: 他是筑基大成，你打不穿他那一层光。躲开那根指头，撑到他出完每一招——阿禾还蹲在岸边。
goal.en: He is Foundation complete; you will not get through that layer of light. Dodge the finger and last until he has spent every move — Ahe is still crouched by the water.

hint.zh: 龟的样子，白身子，红脑袋。
hint.en: A turtle's shape, a white body and a red head.

says.foe: 吾缩甲中，火不能侵，汝亦不能。
says.won: 甲裂了……吾让路便是。
says.lost: 甲还在，汝的力气没了。

says.foe: In my shell, fire cannot reach me. Nor can you.
says.won: My shell cracks… I will make way.
says.lost: The shell holds. Your strength does not.

hint.zh: 白狗的身子，黑脑袋。
hint.en: A white dog's body and a black head.

says.won: 它叫着自己的名字，飞过山脊去了。
says.lost: 它在你头顶转了一圈，飞走了。

says.won: Calling its own name, it flies off over the ridge.
says.lost: It circles once over your head and flies away.

name.en: It Flies at the Sight of Men

hint.zh: 牛的样子，一条红尾巴，脖子上鼓着一个大肉包。
hint.en: Shaped like an ox, with a red tail and a great lump swelling at its neck.

says.won: 它甩着红尾巴，回山里去了。
says.lost: 它一头把你顶翻，哞了一声。

says.won: Switching its red tail, it goes back into the hills.
says.lost: It butts you over and bellows once.

hint.zh: 鱼的身子，四只脚，在浅水里爬。
hint.en: A fish's body on four legs, crawling in the shallows.

says.won: 它扑通一声滑回了水里。
says.lost: 它在水边哭了一夜，你没能近身。

says.won: With a splash it slides back into the water.
says.lost: It cries by the water all night; you never get close.
